clips.title: The story
paras: Apothecary Zamah sends you to silence The Flying Machine Airport above Stonetalon. Carry her Toxic Fogger into the Venture Company’s logging grounds and strike at the cartel’s link to the outside world.

Apothecary Zamah prepares Apothecary Lydon’s toxin for the Venture Company. The tauren seek to protect Stonetalon from deforestation and ravaging machinery, while the Forsaken answer with a different approach. Zamah targets the cartel’s connection beyond the mountains instead of its foot soldiers or loggers. A rumored copter pad carries light cargo and messages between Stonetalon and distant corporate offices.

The Venture Company’s copter pad sits high in the Cragpool Lake area, south of the great waterwheel. The small platform serves lightweight flying machines, not massive zeppelins. You are sent to set off the Toxic Fogger there, filling the pad with toxic vapor before a pilot, courier, or mechanic can alert the company’s commanders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The toxin is ready. All that remains is its delivery. You, friend, must make that delivery.

The Venture Company must have a means of sending messages and light cargo between its headquarters and its operations in Stonetalon. It is likely a small sky port -- not big enough for a zeppelin, but perhaps for a flying machine. You must search the areas in Stonetalon under control of the Venture Company and find this sky port, if it exists. If you find it, then place the toxin there.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You must find the Venture Company airport if it exists, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found the port? Well done, friend! I am sure the goblins were quite surprised from your delivery! Let us hope that toxin finds its way to their headquarters.
You have served your people well, and I advise you to ignore any guilt you might harbor for poisoning the Venture Company. They are deserving of far worse.
And if there is one mote of wisdom the Forsaken might teach its allies, it is this:
Do not shy from dark paths... If those paths lead to victory.
